alt: Painted night scene of an iron footbridge lit by small lamps, crossing a still river from an old brick quarter to glass towers, under a full moon.
Painted night scene of a climber high on a granite wall, clipped into a line of glowing anchors, with a belayer below and a lit valley far beneath.
Painted night scene of a home library with shelves of technical books and manga, a leather armchair, a cat asleep on a cushion, and a desk lamp by a window over a city.
Painted aerial view of a city at night, its avenues glowing like circuit traces around an obelisk, with a wide river along one edge.
Painted night scene inside a greenhouse, rows of seedlings under hanging lamps, taller plants leaning over the newest shoots, a moonlit lake beyond the glass.
Painted night scene of an empty concert stage, orchestra instruments resting at lit music stands around an empty conductor's podium.
Painted scene of a single paper lantern lighting brass gears inside a vast, dark clockwork hall.
Painted night landscape where a glowing heartbeat line in the sky turns into a power line that runs to a village of lit stone houses.
Painted river at dusk turning to night, paper boats on stepping stones passing a small light from one boat to the next.
Painted scene of a lone tree with a lantern on a calm island, while a storm drawn in swirling ink lines circles at a distance.
